mcp_hosts.description: Comma-separated MCP server hosts to include (e.g. 'mcp.calendly.com'). Defaults to every server the caller has connected in the MCP store.

posthog_tools.description: Comma-separated PostHog MCP tool names to describe in full (e.g. 'feature-flag-get-definition'). Without it, the 'posthog' provider lists every tool with a one-line summary.
